title: Setting availability
note: Prevent repeat submissions. Countdown begins only after server confirmation.

title: Couldn’t start
note: Keep chosen duration. Retry uses same operation identifier or reconciles first if outcome is unknown.

title: Available
note: Request pulls one case. No automatic polling or push offers.

title: Request in progress
note: No duplicate request. Timer continues. End availability schedules stop after this request.

title: No cases available
note: Keep availability and countdown. Check again makes one new request.

title: Confirmed request failure
note: Use only after server confirms no assignment. An unknown outcome uses status-checking state.

title: Offline
note: Local countdown reflects server deadline. Mutations require connection; retain selections. Reconcile status after reconnect.

title: Request outcome unknown
note: Reconcile original request ID; do not create duplicate. Assigned case opens; otherwise resolve to empty or failed.

title: Five minutes remaining
note: Proposed warning threshold. Extend and End actions keep same positions.

title: Window ended while idle
note: Set availability returns to inline setup. No case request until new window confirmed.

title: Manually ended
note: After confirmed stop. Return to inline duration setup on CTA.

title: Expired with request pending
note: Honor request sent before deadline. Assigned case opens; no assignment goes to ended state.

title: Stop scheduled
note: Stop intent survives reconnect. Assigned case completes normally; then availability ends. No assignment ends immediately.

title: Extend time sheet
note: Add to latest server deadline on confirmation. Countdown continues behind sheet. Expired window requires explicit Start wording; do not silently restart. Retry is idempotent.

title: Adding time
note: Add to latest server deadline on confirmation. Countdown continues behind sheet. Expired window requires explicit Start wording; do not silently restart. Retry is idempotent.

title: Extension failed
note: Add to latest server deadline on confirmation. Countdown continues behind sheet. Expired window requires explicit Start wording; do not silently restart. Retry is idempotent.

title: Expired while extending
note: Add to latest server deadline on confirmation. Countdown continues behind sheet. Expired window requires explicit Start wording; do not silently restart. Retry is idempotent.

title: Extension confirmed
note: Brief confirmation; authoritative new deadline. Remain on Home.

title: End availability sheet
note: Close or Keep dismisses without change. Server confirmation required. Unknown stop result reconciles before allowing new requests. Saving locks controls.

title: Ending availability
note: Close or Keep dismisses without change. Server confirmation required. Unknown stop result reconciles before allowing new requests. Saving locks controls.

title: Couldn’t end availability
note: Close or Keep dismisses without change. Server confirmation required. Unknown stop result reconciles before allowing new requests. Saving locks controls.

title: End during request
note: Close or Keep dismisses without change. Server confirmation required. Unknown stop result reconciles before allowing new requests. Saving locks controls.

title: Help
note: Message and call launch configured native destinations. Report requires explicit submission. In live case Call is hidden during patient call.

title: Report app issue
note: Draft diagnostic disclosure; app team must finalize exact fields. Keyboard screen scrolls input and CTA into view.

title: Report submitted
note: Reference is a mock, replaced by actual report ID. Send failure preserves description.

title: Report failed
note: Retry same report to avoid duplicates. Preserve typed description.

title: Notifications empty
note: No push offers. Opening inbox does not end availability.

title: Notifications list
note: Illustrative content only. Unread state and list/detail navigation required.

title: Announcement detail
note: Illustrative announcement; no forced update during live case.

title: Notifications failed
note: Availability continues. Retain cached list when available.

title: Profile
note: Read-only approved record; no invented registration number. Log out absent during case or request in flight.

title: Wallet placeholder
note: No balance, KYC, bank details, payout or withdrawal actions in current scope.

title: Faster sign-in settings
note: Explicit tap invokes native credential setup. OS controls biometric/PIN UI. Cancellation stays here. Existing credential shows enabled and Turn off confirmation.

title: Log out confirmation
note: Proposed: end window and revoke session atomically; no logout while request/case active. On failure remain signed in and reconcile.

title: Loading notifications
note: Show cached content if available; otherwise loading state. Back remains available.

title: Sending report
note: Prevent duplicate submission. Preserve description until server confirms receipt.

title: Post-crash report offer
note: Proposed occasional prompt after state reconciliation. Never interrupt or obscure an active case on recovery. Automatic crash logging is separate.

title: Faster sign-in enabled
note: Turning off requires confirmation. Does not remove other accounts’ device credentials.

title: Setup cancelled or failed
note: OS cancellation is neutral. Native error may supply actionable reason. No repeat prompt without user action.

title: Disable faster sign-in
note: After success return to settings off state. Failure preserves enabled state; server/device credential behavior requires app-team validation.

title: New-phone confirmation
note: Proposed JTBD rule. Native session policy remains open; not an approved auth change.

title: Live case on other phone
note: Proposed device-switch guard; do not interrupt current doctor case.

title: Old phone signed out
note: Proposed session-takeover result after server confirms no live case.
